rules.description: WT international: block identified AI agents at interactive entry
rules.expression: (http.host eq "wt.mrtreasure.cc" and not (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/about/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/assets/") or http.request.uri.path in {"/robots.txt" "/sitemap.xml" "/llms.txt" "/favicon.ico" "/404.html"})) and cf.verified_bot_category in {"AI Assistant" "AI Crawler" "AI Search"}

rules.description: WT international: challenge anonymous tool entry; preserve verified search crawlers
rules.expression: (http.host eq "wt.mrtreasure.cc" and not (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/about/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/assets/") or http.request.uri.path in {"/robots.txt" "/sitemap.xml" "/llms.txt" "/favicon.ico" "/404.html"})) and not (cf.client.bot and cf.verified_bot_category eq "Search Engine Crawler")

challengePassageScope: mrtreasure.cc zone setting; not a per-rule or QMuse setting
